## Scope

The quality audit reviewed 522 second reads taken during the quarter. The review considered the consistency between the first and second grades assigned to each set. It was undertaken to assess grading agreement and to identify any issues requiring follow-up. The audit findings provide an overall view of grading quality for the period covered.

## Result

First and second grades agreed in 61.1 per cent of sets reviewed. This result is reported as the overall agreement for the audit and should be considered alongside the detailed information in the attached spreadsheet. Per-grader results are provided in that spreadsheet for review. The findings will also be discussed privately with each grader, allowing any points arising from the audit to be considered directly and supporting appropriate follow-up where required.
